description: 21 pending world cult-hero proposals; Valeron recruited as a playable ELITE.

candidates.name: Tony Yeboah
candidates.rationale: Thunderbolt volleys against Liverpool and Wimbledon, unforgettable Leeds icon.

candidates.name: Joaquín Sánchez
candidates.rationale: The embodiment of Betis, flamboyant winger with a historic 622 La Liga appearances.

candidates.name: Antonio Di Natale
candidates.rationale: Remarkable longevity, inventive finishing, and deep one-club identification at Udinese.

candidates.name: Guti
candidates.rationale: Ridiculous disguised passes and backheels, more creative brilliance than conventional consistency.

candidates.name: Michu
candidates.rationale: The iconic 18-goal Premier League 2012/13 breakthrough, cut short by injuries.

candidates.name: Dimitri Payet
candidates.rationale: Tight curls, audacious free kicks and extraordinary attacking vision.

candidates.name: Lee Trundle
candidates.rationale: A genuine lower-league showboat king, dazzling tricks and inventive finishes.

candidates.name: Elano
candidates.rationale: One of Manchester City's early cult technicians with spectacular dead-ball ability.

candidates.name: Geovanni
candidates.rationale: Spectacular long shots including the shock Hull City win away at Arsenal.

candidates.name: Jérémy Ménez
candidates.rationale: Mercurial winger with outrageous dribbles and an iconic Milan backheel finish.

candidates.name: Sofiane Boufal
candidates.rationale: 2017/18 Premier League Goal of the Season winner for solo dribbling against West Brom.

candidates.name: Gervinho
candidates.rationale: Chaotic, explosive ball-carrying and breakaway runs at Roma.

candidates.name: Javier Saviola
candidates.rationale: The Rabbit, teenage sensation who scored eleven goals at the 2001 U20 World Cup.

candidates.name: Yacine Brahimi
candidates.rationale: Exceptional one-on-one dribbler and creator, especially at Porto.

candidates.name: Ali Karimi
candidates.rationale: Asia's technical magician and 2004 AFC Player of the Year.

candidates.name: Faustino Asprilla
candidates.rationale: Charismatic and unpredictable attacker, famous for European nights at Newcastle.

candidates.name: Alexandre Pato
candidates.rationale: Electric early AC Milan rise, remarkable straight-line ball carrying and finishing.

candidates.name: Mauro Zárate
candidates.rationale: Powerful cut-ins, dribbles and long-distance shooting during his Lazio peak.

candidates.name: Royston Drenthe
candidates.rationale: Unruly flair, physical acceleration and cult status exceeding career consistency.

candidates.name: Keisuke Honda
candidates.rationale: Unmistakable left foot, dead-ball authority and 2010 World Cup heroics.

candidates.name: Mário Jardel
candidates.rationale: Two European Golden Shoes and an astonishing scoring record; legend of finishing, not automatically STREET HERO.
